text:
michael: Heads-up — overnight we saw a bunch of tiny streamed frames and a bump in WS disconnects in prod-us-east-1. Any quick pointers on where to start digging?

sophia: Start with the streaming overview dashboard (Grafana) and then logs/traces. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/streaming-overview?orgId=1&var-region=us-east-1 
Logs (Datadog): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=ws%20disconnects 
Traces (Jaeger): https://jaeger.redwood/internal/search?service=streaming 
Useful metrics: ws_stream_chunk_latency_ms (p95/p99), ws_disconnect_rate, ws_stream_open_count

ben: Also check streaming_kv_cache_hit_ratio and streaming_prefix_cache_miss_rate. Low cache hit -> lots of tiny frames because clients re-send prefixes. Seen this before.

michael: Good call. Our old alert ws_partial_frame_rate keeps firing but it's noisy. Any threshold suggestions?

julia: Proposal to cut noise: combine rate + latency and require sustained window. Example rules I want to PR: 1) ws_disconnect_rate > 0.5% over 5m AND chunk_latency_p95 > 300ms, 2) ws_partial_frame_rate > 0.1% sustained 10m. I'll open a PR to infra/alerts.

julia: Snippet I'll include in the PR for the partial-frame alert:
```yaml
- alert: HighWSPartialFrames
  expr: increase(ws_partial_frame_count[10m]) / max(1, increase(ws_stream_open_count[10m])) > 0.001
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High partial frame rate in {{ $labels.region }}"
    runbook: "https://runbooks.redwood.internal/streaming-partial-frames"
```

david: sgtm but add an additional p99 chunk latency alert ( > 1s ) so we can page before disconnects cascade. Also include which teams to page.

infra-bot: Runbook created: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/streaming-partial-frames — includes playbook for checking client versions, cache metrics, and a query list.

michael: julia can you also add a dashboard panel for frame-size histogram and a note on correlating frame-size spikes with client versions? I suspect older client SDKs emit many small frames.

julia: yup, adding panel + annotation. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/compare/alerts/1234 — assigning @ben for cache metric verification and @sophia for dash links and trace queries.

ben: :thumbsup: will validate cache queries. preliminary histogram query for Grafana (Prometheus): 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ws_frame_size_bytes_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
```
I'll paste a nicer panel config in the PR.

sophia: FYI tracing requires header x-redwood-trace to correlate client spans. Jaeger search link again: https://jaeger.redwood/internal/search?service=streaming&lookback=1h

michael: ok — if infra + ops don't object I'll merge after 24h. julia — please link the PR number in the runbook and the alerts file. Thanks all.

julia: noted. I'll mark the PR as draft and request reviews from @ben and @sophia, then move to ready when panels are in.

michael: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick triage. We'll monitor the dashboard this afternoon and escalate if pages fire. :rocket:
